[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Day strip, redesigned — two calm lines under the daily note's plan [/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]On every canonical daily note that has a `bob-plan` block, the Day [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]strip renders directly under the plan badges, in Live Preview and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Reading view, as two calm, readable lines. The first line holds [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]CLOSED not yet`). The second holds the area time mix plus `so far ·[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]HH:MM`. Nothing overlaps or overflows under real Obsidian styles, a[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]preview harness enforces that, and the CodeMirror end-of-note mount[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is gone.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]New Day strip look — facts line, time-mix line, no buttons, [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]model, painter, and CSS into the two-line layout of the design contract.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Use LABEL-value facts, then a time-mix row with `so far · HH:MM`. Drop [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]`<button>` elements. Rebuild the preview matrix so it applies Obsidian's[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline button and link rules, places the strip under mock plan badges,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and fails on overflow, overlap, a skeleton height mismatch, or a busted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]budget. Rewrite the model and painter tests, then sync.[/#D7D7AF]
